review.assessment: This change creates `invoice.py` and implements `invoice_total` by applying tax individually to each item in a loop and summing the results. It fails to compute tax once on the aggregated subtotal as required, preserving the per-line-item rounding error instead of fixing it.

findings.actual: Tax is applied and rounded for each item individually before being summed, yielding a compounded rounding error (e.g., ~108 cents total).
findings.call: `sum(with_tax(c, rate_pct) for c in [33, 33, 33])` or equivalent `invoice_total([33, 33, 33], 10)` invocation
findings.defect: Tax calculation still occurs per line item instead of once on the summed total
findings.expected: Tax computed on the subtotal sum once and rounded once, yielding a correct total (e.g., 109 cents).
